mentions.name: Eazip
mentions.description: This API service lets developers bundle remote files (from S3, R2, CDN, or other URLs) into a ZIP archive with a single POST request: the service fetches the files, packages them, and returns a signed download link. It supports ZIP64 for files over 4GB, up to 5,000 files per job, zero egress fees on downloads, and requires no infrastructure to manage. A free tier is available without a credit card.
mentions.problem: Creating ZIPs from remote files (S3, R2, CDN) usually means downloading to a server, zipping locally, managing temp storage, and cleaning up, which is painful at scale, especially with large files or thousands of items.
mentions.audience: The comment targets developers building on top of the API, with feedback requested from the HN community.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Eazip (https://eazip.io) — ZIP remote files in one API call.

I built a service that lets developers bundle remote files into a ZIP with a single POST request. You send a list of URLs, we fetch, package, and return a signed download link.
